paper.title_en: Isomeric yield ratios of fission products in the $^{232}$Th(γ, f) reaction with the bremsstrahlung end-point energies of 14 and 16 MeV
paper.abstract_en: Isomeric yield ratios (IRs) of the fission products $^{130,132}$Sb, $^{131,133}$Te, $^{134,136}$I, $^{135}$Xe, and $^{138}$Cs were measured in the photofission of $^{232}$Th using bremsstrahlung end-point energies of 14 and 16 MeV. The experiments were performed at the 20 MeV ELBE electron linac (Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf), employing an off-line γ-ray spectrometric technique. From the measured IR values, the average root-mean-square angular momenta (J$_{RMS}$) of the primary fragments were deduced using a spin-dependent statistical model analysis. The results demonstrate that J$_{RMS}$ values of fission fragments with a spherical N = 82 shell are significantly lower than those for fragments without a closed neutron shell. Furthermore, the J$_{RMS}$ of odd-Z fission products were found to be higher than those of adjacent even-Z products, suggesting a distinct single particle effect. These findings highlight the significant influence of nuclear structure on the fission process. A comparison with literature data at different energies suggests that the excitation energy of the compound nucleus has a negligible effect on the fragment angular momentum within the studied energy range.
